properties.source: Willett Trail Tiot Trail Leg brochure (5 March 2026)
properties.name: Willett School Tiot Trail leg
properties.section_description: Planned 0.37-mile Tiot Trail leg behind Willett School, from the easement to Westover Parkway. Red follows the brochure. Approximate alignment registered to the mapped school building footprint using the supplied satellite crop.
properties.alignment_method: Actual red-pixel centerline from supplied satellite crop. Shape-preserving similarity registration: uniform 0.415681 metres per image pixel plus rotation and translation, fitted to four school roof corners. Replaces affine registration; no differential horizontal/vertical stretching.
